name: EuAuthorisationNumber
title: EU authorisation number
description: An EU marketing authorisation number, EU/1/YY/NNN/PPP (YY the year, NNN the product in three or four digits, PPP the presentation), as a RegulatedAuthorization's identifier: one RegulatedAuthorization per number, one number per RegulatedAuthorization. https://khs.dev/fhir/StructureDefinition/eu-product-identity holds every value to ^EU/1/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{3,4}/[0-9]{3}$ (khs-eu-1, khs-eu-3).
